status: scientific assessment specification frozen; execution not authorized and no assessment pool generated
question: Does the frozen original-task selected executable improve F and escape over the original seed on fresh cases?
conditions: Unmodified original maze and objective. Two frozen programs; no new learning interventions or manually fitted comparator in this assessment.
primary_contrast: Equal-episode paired mean F: selected minus seed. Report 95% paired bootstrap interval; meaningful improvement specified as 0.05 F. No sample-size extension based on significance.

analysis.method: Resample all 256 whole paired case indices jointly for every contrast/metric. Invalid executions remain in denominators with F=0. Mean episode A, not globally pooled cell accuracy. Preserve binary discordant counts.
analysis.escape_uncertainty: Paired episode bootstrap plus separate-arm Wilson intervals. Explicitly flag degenerate bootstrap at boundary; no claim of perfect population success.

precision_rationale.design: 256 pairs prospectively proposed in original staged plan before selection results; retain that sample size.
precision_rationale.interpretation: Planning approximations, not promised achieved precision. Selection failures increase variance relative to the 32-case development panel. Paired binary worst-case halfwidth is about0.123; no guaranteed precision for small escape-rate differences.
precision_rationale.meaningful_F_difference: 0.05 is approximately the composite contribution of one extra collected key (0.6 * 20 / 250 = 0.048), holding other reward components and reconstruction constant.

pool.draw_after: Separate user authorization and binding of an execution deadline to this frozen specification.
pool.sampling: Same63bit independent private draw; reject all values below1000000 and every integer from all prior private seed pools, including Stage4. Pair both arms exactly.

claim_limits: Comparison against the original greedy/random seed, not a competent handcrafted pathfinder.
One selected program from one short search; no independent-discovery reliability or causal contribution of Shinka mechanisms.
Current-map reconstruction under different actions is not matched-experience prediction learning.
No causal isolation of memory, planning or adaptation.
